summary: Recent updates to Firefox's general functionality have introduced several important improvements, particularly in media handling and audio processing. One significant change is the enhancement of the **audio processing pipeline**, which now features a more robust buffering system for audio packets, helping to improve overall playback quality. Additionally, Firefox has improved its handling of video playback during seeking by allowing a **smoother transition with minimal delay**, ensuring a better experience when navigating through videos. Furthermore, changes to the handling of cross-origin requests have strengthened security by preventing potential tainting of same-origin responses from service workers, ultimately enhancing user privacy. Overall, these updates aim to refine Firefox's multimedia capabilities and security features, providing users with a smoother and safer browsing experience.
